rubric_items.reason: Every component sits on an existing api, db or web module and follows the layering (service rules, repo SQL, new migration file). The one new piece, the in-process timer, was decided by A-08 and its mismatch is recorded.

Every story has components mapped to it. But S-1 AC1 (Stale at exactly the 24h mark) is only met up to an hour late under the hourly sweep, and S-7's glossary entry is put in docs/PRD.md, not in the glossary the inputs actually use.

Endpoint fields have type, nullability, format and example. Gaps: history[].event is typed string rather than an enum, the STALE event's from/to/note values are not given, and CO-5 does not say how server.ts builds the service and clock.

Code claims are cited and check out against the pinned code. CO-11 is honestly marked Assumed, but its basis is weak: docs/PRD.md has no glossary, and context/glossary.md is the glossary that req and split use.

Each non-obvious choice has a trade-off line: putting the timer in server.ts, running once at start, the hourly interval, keeping Stale out of the overlap constraints, and having no interval env setting.
Clear and consistent. The front matter and body agree, and the stories-served line maps every story.
